==> certs/files.crtlist (plaintext, whole file)
/etc/switchyard/certs/files-example-test.pem files.example.test

==> haproxy/haproxy.cfg (haproxy, whole file)
# Managed by Switchyard. Do not edit: changes are reported as drift.
# SE group: edge
# switchyard-render: sha256:3506bdf30488550e05481ed7bbaa26c92e9a362847bfd006f00b24cd0e29b1ac

global
    log /dev/log local0
    maxconn 20000
    stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 660 level admin expose-fd listeners
    ssl-default-bind-options ssl-min-ver TLSv1.2 no-tls-tickets
    ssl-default-server-options ssl-min-ver TLSv1.2

defaults
    log global
    option dontlognull
    option redispatch
    retries 3
    timeout connect 5s
    timeout client 50s
    timeout server 50s
    timeout http-request 10s
    timeout http-keep-alive 10s
    timeout tunnel 1h

# Local health endpoint for keepalived's check script and the agent's route-health watchdog.
frontend sy_local_health
    mode http
    bind 127.0.0.1:8404
    monitor-uri /healthz
    no log

frontend vs_files
    mode http
    bind 192.0.2.23:80
    bind 192.0.2.23:443 ssl crt-list /etc/switchyard/certs/files.crtlist alpn http/1.1
    option httplog
    option forwardfor
    http-request return status 200 content-type text/plain lf-string "%[path,map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/acme-http01.map)]" if { dst_port 80 } { path,map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/acme-http01.map) -m found }
    http-request del-header X-Forwarded-For
    http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto https if { ssl_fc }
    http-request set-header X-Forwarded-Proto http if !{ ssl_fc }
    http-request set-var(txn.host) req.hdr(host),field(1,:),lower
    http-request redirect prefix "https://%[var(txn.host)]" code 301 if { dst_port 80 }
    http-request redirect location /remote.php/dav/ code 301 if { path_beg /.well-known/carddav }
    http-request redirect location /remote.php/dav/ code 301 if { path_beg /.well-known/caldav }
    http-request redirect location https://files.example.test/new code 302 if { var(txn.host) -m str files.example.test } { path /old }
    use_backend pool_docs if { var(txn.host) -m str files.example.test } { path_beg /docs }
    use_backend %[var(txn.host),map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/files-host.map)] if { var(txn.host),map(/etc/switchyard/haproxy/maps/files-host.map) -m found }

backend pool_docs
    mode http
    balance roundrobin
    server 10-20-3-8-8080 10.20.3.8:8080 weight 100

backend pool_nextcloud
    mode http
    balance roundrobin
    server 10-20-3-7-11000 10.20.3.7:11000 weight 100

==> haproxy/maps/acme-http01.map (plaintext, whole file)
# ACME HTTP-01 answers are added at run time (Switchyard).

==> haproxy/maps/files-host.map (plaintext, whole file)
files.example.test pool_nextcloud
